name: 1DD-LSD
summary: 1DD-LSD, also known as 1-dodecanoyl-LSD or as SYN-L-004, is an acylated derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). In animal studies, it produces a weak head-twitch response but with 27x lower potency than LSD itself. It is being researched as a potential slow-onset, long lasting prodrug for LSD which is expected to have reduced psychoactive effects.

pharmacology.text: It is being researched as a potential slow-onset, long lasting prodrug for LSD which is expected to have reduced psychoactive effects.

uses.en: It is being researched as a slow release form of LSD that the body would convert gradually.
uses.zh: 它正被研究作為一種緩釋型LSD，讓身體逐步將其轉化。
uses.zhHans: 它正被研究作为一种缓释型LSD，让身体逐步将其转化。

sideEffects.en: Its effects in people are not known. In animals it caused only a weak version of the response that LSD causes.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的作用未知。在動物實驗中，它只引起比LSD弱得多的反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的作用未知。在动物实验中，它只引起比LSD弱得多的反应。

fact.en: Its dodecanoyl chain has twelve carbon atoms, the same chain as lauric acid, the main fatty acid in coconut oil.
fact.zh: 它的十二醯基有十二個碳原子，與月桂酸的碳鏈相同，而月桂酸是椰子油中的主要脂肪酸。
fact.zhHans: 它的十二酰基有十二个碳原子，与月桂酸的碳链相同，而月桂酸是椰子油中的主要脂肪酸。
